description:
Ignite IT is seeking a Junior AI Prompt Engineer to support U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP). In this role, you will work directly with stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI adoption, develop and refine prompts, design AI-enabled workflows, and support the implementation of AI solutions that improve mission and business operations. 
 The ideal candidate is passionate about artificial intelligence, enjoys solving complex problems, and can translate business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions. Candidates may come from backgrounds such as workflow automation, business analysis, software development, process improvement, technical consulting, or AI implementation. 
 This role focuses on helping users adopt and apply AI technologies. 
 Responsibilities 
 Work with stakeholders to understand business processes, gather requirements, identify operational pain points, and evaluate opportunities for AI adoption. 
 Design, test, refine, and document reusable prompts and prompt workflows for approved large language model platforms. 
 Develop and support AI-enabled workflows that improve operational efficiency and automate manual processes. 
 Support demonstrations, training sessions, and user adoption activities that help stakeholders effectively leverage AI capabilities. 
 Use approved AI platforms to assist stakeholders with research, summarization, reporting, analysis, and development of decision-support content. 
 Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, reliability, and alignment with mission requirements. 
 Research emerging AI capabilities and identify practical use cases that support mission objectives. 
 Support rapid prototyping, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of AI solutions. 
 Document AI use cases, workflows, findings, lessons learned, and recommendations. 
 Collaborate with technical teams to support deployment and integration efforts. 
 Identify opportunities for advanced AI capabilities, automation, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI solutions and coordinate with technical teams as needed. 
  
 Requirements 
 U.S. Citizenship. 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
 Experience applying AI tools to solve business, operational, academic, or technical problems. 
 Experience designing, testing, or refining prompts for generative AI platforms. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into practical solutions. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. 
  
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Make.com, Zapier, LangFlow, or similar platforms. 
 Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts. 
 Experience with AI agents, chatbots, or conversational AI solutions. 
 Exposure to APIs, scripting, software development, or low-code/no-code platforms. 
 Experience identifying, documenting, or improving business processes. 
 Experience supporting AI adoption, user training, or technology implementation efforts. 
 Experience working in a federal government environment. 
 Familiarity with prompt evaluation, output validation, and responsible AI practices. 
  
 Benefits 
 401(k) with matching and 100% Vested
 Health Insurance - 3 plans to select from
 Dental insurance
 Vision Insurance
 Health savings account
 Life insurance
 Short Term Disability
 Long Term Disability
 AD&D
 Paid time off
 Professional development assistance
 Training
 Tuition reimbursement
 Flexible schedule
 Flexible spending account
 Referral program
 Paid Legal Plan
 and more....
 
 Ignite IT is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, Veteran status, sexual orientation, or other protected characteristic. In accordance with EO 13665 Final Rule, Ignite IT will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant.
 Applicants selected may be required to possess and maintain a government clearance
 US CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED
